text:
Maria (PM): Quick proposal for Embedded SDK GA entry criteria — keeping it tight so legal/commercial can review. Need signoff on gates: SLAs, docs checklist, support routing, monitoring, and pricing behavior. Draft below. Thoughts?

Ben (Eng): Skim looks good. Can we avoid hard p50 targets? customersMostlyCare about p95/p99.

Maria (PM): Agreed. Proposed SLA tiers (hosted SDK only):
- Bronze (free dev): no SLA, usage flagged for fair-use throttling
- Silver (paid): availability 99.5%, error rate <0.2%, p95 token latency <300ms
- Gold (enterprise): availability 99.95%, error rate <0.05%, p99 token latency <800ms + dedicated synthetic checks
Customer-hosted SDK gets best-effort guidance + a "compatibility checklist" but no formal SLA.

Priya (SRE): For monitoring/alerts we need three surfaces:
1) Service health (global 5xx rate, pod restarts) — alert when 5xx > 0.5% for 10m
2) SDK telemetry (client queue latency, buffer flush failures) — alert when flush failures > 0.1% for 5m
3) Per-customer canaries — alert when canary p99 > 1s for 15m
Add a Pager duty playbook: notify SRE on Gold tier, Ops on Silver after escalation window.

Sam (Docs): I'll create a GA docs checklist page with required sections: quickstart, SDK config examples, telemetry contract (metrics names & units), integration test checklist, rollout checklist for partners, and rollback instructions. Need an SDK config sample from Eng so I can copy it exactly.

Ben (Eng): Sample SDK config we can publish:

```json
{
  "mode": "hosted",
  "tier": "silver",
  "telemetry": {
    "heartbeat_ms": 45000,
    "buffer_ms": 1500,
    "metrics_prefix": "sdk.client"
  },
  "fallback": {
    "strategy": "graceful_degrade",
    "max_tokens_fallback": 128
  }
}
```

Ben (Eng): telemetry names: `sdk.client.heartbeat_ms`, `sdk.client.buffer_ms`, `sdk.client.flush_failures` — Sam can reference these.

Priya (SRE): Canary cadence: run a rolling canary per-customer every 10m; keep 7d of history before GA. Synthetic should exercise short, mid, and long token paths.

Maria (PM): Rollout gates (all required):
- Docs checklist published and reviewed by Docs + Legal
- Support routing defined: Ops gets entitlement lookup and playbook (Sam + @ops-bot)
- Telemetry contract signed off by Eng + SRE
- 3 pilot customers onboarded and each pass a 7d stability window (no sev1/2 incidents)
- Billing/pricing appendix: soft-throttle policy + warning emails enabled for Silver by default

ops-bot: Task created: "embedded-sdk-ga-gates" assigned to Maria, Ben, Priya, Sam. Due: 2025-07-15. Status: in_progress.

Sam (Docs): Timeline: I can get a first pass of the checklist + SDK snippet by Tue EOD. Will include sample escalation emails and entitlement matrix.

Ben (Eng): I'll add telemetry hooks and the `metrics_prefix` instrumentation by Friday. Also adding a lightweight local-offline-mode doc for partners.

Priya (SRE): I'll draft the Prometheus alert rules and a one-page runbook for Ops. Need the pilot customer list to wire canaries into CI. Maria?

Maria (PM): Will DM pilot list now and update the tracking doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/embedded-sdk-ga (proto). I propose we consider GA when all gates pass and commercial signs off.

Ben (Eng): One open question — pricing behavior when customers exceed expected token volume. Recommend: soft throttles at 90% of committed throughput + billing notice; hard throttle only after 24h sustained overage or explicit safety trigger.

Maria (PM): That matches my intent. We'll include thresholds in the pricing appendix and a customer communication plan.

Sam (Docs): Noted. I'll draft customer-facing FAQ and an internal runbook entry for "how to lift throttles".

Maria (PM): OK if nobody objects Ill mark these as the GA baseline and start the legal/commercial draft. Reply with :thumbsup: to agree.

Ben (Eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (SRE): :thumbsup:

Sam (Docs): :thumbsup:

Maria (PM): Thanks team — I'll stitch together the draft and ping for review.
